summary: Data443 Risk Mitigation, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Financial Service Agreement with Margaret Z. Holdings Limited for advisory services regarding its proposed de-SPAC business combination with Four Leaf Acquisition Corporation (FORL). Compensation includes a $1M promissory note, 1.2M PubCo shares, a retention cash bonus tied to trust assets and performance metrics, and nominee share arrangements. CEO Jason Remillard holds roles at both entities, making this a related-party transaction. The agreement runs 18 months; terms are subject to FORL special committee and SPAC shareholder approval. Watch for regulatory delays or shareholder dissent typical in SPAC mergers.
